description: Implementation of IOBuffer classes and related buffer management utilities in the net namespace, including IOBuffer, IOBufferWithSize, StringIOBuffer, DrainableIOBuffer, GrowableIOBuffer, PickledIOBuffer, and WrappedIOBuffer.

classes.name: IOBuffer
classes.description: Base class for buffer management, providing data pointer and buffer validation.

classes.name: IOBufferWithSize
classes.description: Derived from IOBuffer, adds size management.

classes.name: StringIOBuffer
classes.description: Derived from IOBuffer, manages string data buffers.

classes.name: DrainableIOBuffer
classes.description: Derived from IOBuffer, supports consuming bytes and tracking remaining data.

classes.name: GrowableIOBuffer
classes.description: Resizable buffer supporting dynamic capacity and offset management.

classes.name: PickledIOBuffer
classes.description: Buffer that can be serialized/deserialized, with a Done method to finalize data.

classes.name: WrappedIOBuffer
classes.description: Wraps existing const data into an IOBuffer.

methods.name: AssertValidBufferSize
methods.description: Validates buffer size, accepting size_t or int.

methods.name: IOBuffer(char* data)
methods.description: Constructs IOBuffer with existing data pointer.

methods.name: IOBufferWithSize(char* data, size_t size)
methods.description: Constructor for IOBufferWithSize with data and size.

methods.name: StringIOBuffer(std::unique_ptr<std::string> s)
methods.description: Constructs StringIOBuffer from a unique_ptr to string.

methods.name: DrainableIOBuffer(scoped_refptr<IOBuffer> base, int size)
methods.description: Constructs DrainableIOBuffer with base buffer and size.

methods.name: DrainableIOBuffer(scoped_refptr<IOBuffer> base, size_t size)
methods.description: Constructs DrainableIOBuffer with base buffer and size.

methods.name: StartOfBuffer()
methods.description: Returns pointer to start of buffer.
